notes: Source build requires pre-provisioned Rust/Cargo and a C linker; tested with Rust 1.99.1.
Only the custom signless-i64 dialect is functionally qualified; the pliron LLVM dialect and general compiler semantics are outside this check.
The binary is Linux x86_64, built on glibc 2.39. Distribution fields record the build host and are not an installation allowlist.
